scope: Colorectal tissue methylation: fixed-budget selector/classifier comparison with independent-cohort transfer.
notes: No claim that this targeted source check is a systematic or exhaustive review. Every result attributed to prior papers is reported by those papers, not reproduced by this pilot.

references.title: Differences in DNA methylation signatures reveal multiple pathways of progression from adenoma to colorectal cancer
references.verified_findings: The GSE48684 source study used HumanMethylation450 arrays: 41 normal colon tissues, 42 adenomas, and 64 cancers. It investigated methylation-defined adenoma and carcinoma heterogeneity.
references.relevance: Dataset provenance and biological context for the colorectal tissue pilot.
references.caution: Exclude adenomas explicitly. Normal-H and normal-C differ in donor clinical context. Equal tumor/normal-C numeric title suffixes do not reliably establish donor pairs (sex discordance). Primary full text was subsequently accessible through PMC.

references.title: Methylome profiling reveals functions and genes which are differentially methylated in serrated compared to conventional colorectal carcinoma
references.verified_findings: Primary GSE68060 study compared serrated and conventional colorectal cancers using 450K methylation arrays and validated DIO3/FOXD2-related findings at molecular levels.
references.relevance: External-cohort provenance; biological heterogeneity and tumor-adjacent normal tissues affect transfer.
references.caution: Paper reports 103 colorectal specimens while the current GEO record lists 120 samples. The analyzed counts must be derived from the actual downloaded metadata, exclusions and donor identifiers, not copied from the abstract.

references.title: Colon cancer-specific diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers based on genome-wide abnormal DNA methylation
references.verified_findings: Selected ten diagnostic CpGs and fitted a BayesNet model. TCGA training comprised 200 COAD and 25 normal tissues; validation comprised 99 and 13. Tested five independent GEO cohorts, including GSE48684, with reported AUC at least 0.951.
references.relevance: Direct prior colorectal methylation classification and external validation.
references.caution: Compact CpG panels and GEO validation are established. Published AUC is contextual, not numerically comparable to our different cohorts, metric and selection pipeline; the paper also studies prognosis, which is outside our task.

references.title: SEPTIN9-SDC2-VIM methylation signature as a biomarker for the early diagnosis of colorectal cancer
references.verified_findings: Selected one TCGA 450K probe for each of three predefined genes (SEPTIN9, SDC2 and VIM), using fold change; fitted logistic regression and evaluated independent tissue datasets. A separate blood-based model was developed using new measurements.
references.relevance: Direct precedent for compact interpretable colorectal methylation classification and independent validation.
references.caution: No DOI is listed in the checked PubMed/PMC record; use PMID or URL. Do not imply that the tissue-trained model was directly transferred unchanged to blood. Do not compare its reported AUC with our balanced accuracy as if identical tasks.

references.title: A Hybrid Ensemble Approach for Identifying Robust Differentially Methylated Loci in Pan-Cancers
references.verified_findings: HyDML combines resampling/instance perturbation and diverse feature-selection functions (glmnet, MDFS, rmcfs) with SVM classification across 13 TCGA cancers. Reports Jaccard feature stability and independent breast, liver and lung dataset tests.
references.relevance: Prior work explicitly covers stable CpG feature selection and ensemble evaluation.
references.caution: Do not claim resampling, feature stability, Jaccard or independent testing are new. The total sample count in the article is internally inconsistent; avoid repeating it.

references.title: DNA methylation biomarkers-based pan-cancer classifier: predictive modeling for cancer classification
references.verified_findings: Compared seven ML algorithms with grouped, stratified nested cross-validation and balanced accuracy. Curated 10,756 primary profiles across 54 tissue categories and 2,306 validation profiles from 28 studies. Effect-size-based feature selection and anomaly filtering were included; logistic regression attained reported BACC 0.90 using 1,208 CpGs.
references.relevance: Very close methodological prior art: controlled ML comparison, donor grouping, external validation and primary balanced accuracy already exist.
references.caution: This is a pan-cancer multiclass framework, not our fixed-budget binary colorectal selector-by-classifier experiment. Do not claim novelty for simple models, nested CV, BACC, leakage control or external validation alone.

references.title: When complexity does not pay: benchmarking deep learning and ensemble methods for biomarker discovery
references.verified_findings: Reports benchmarking 27 feature-selection strategies and 11 predictive models across Alzheimer disease, progressive supranuclear palsy and breast cancer cohorts; considers performance, stability and biological interpretation.
references.relevance: Broader multi-omics benchmarking precedent: increased algorithmic complexity does not ensure better prediction.
references.caution: Not a colorectal-only DNA methylation benchmark. Publisher abstract and metadata verified in indexed publisher results; direct full-text access blocked. Do not infer detailed train/test protocol from the abstract.

references.title: On the impact of weighting informative features in the decision-making process
references.journal: Eurasian Journal of Mathematical and Computer Applications
references.verified_findings: An illustrative methodological study explores how feature weighting affects classification, clustering and ranking using a small two-feature example.
references.relevance: An EJMCA source relevant only to explicitly controlled feature transformations and the rationale for keeping preprocessing fixed.
references.caution: Not a DNA methylation study, not an oncology benchmark and not a new predictive algorithm. Cite one specific methodological point, not to inflate clinical evidence. Given-name initials are retained because the publisher page lists initials.

references.title: On Over-fitting in Model Selection and Subsequent Selection Bias in Performance Evaluation
references.verified_findings: Shows that model selection itself can overfit a finite-sample evaluation criterion and bias reported performance.
references.relevance: Supports separating all selection and tuning from final external evaluation.
references.caution: An evaluation design that happens to use CV is not automatically unbiased. State the actually implemented tuning protocol; do not label fixed-parameter CV nested CV.

references.title: On the Stability of Feature Selection Algorithms
references.verified_findings: Provides a statistical framework for feature-selection stability, including a chance-corrected measure, confidence intervals and hypothesis tests.
references.relevance: Explains why predictive performance and robustness of selected feature sets are different properties.
references.caution: If the pilot only computes pairwise Jaccard, describe it as descriptive Jaccard stability; do not claim implementation of the Nogueira statistic.

references.title: Scikit-learn: Machine Learning in Python
references.verified_findings: Describes the scikit-learn machine-learning software library.
references.relevance: Software citation for the implemented pipeline; record actual installed package versions separately.
references.caution: The 2011 paper does not establish the exact behavior of the currently installed version; reproduce using the package manifest.

references.title: Two histologically colorectal carcinomas subsets from the serrated pathway show different methylome signatures and diagnostic biomarkers
references.verified_findings: Compared methylome signatures of serrated adenocarcinomas with a high-microsatellite-instability colorectal histological subtype, adding nine matched hmMSI-H tumors to the methylome comparison. Data availability identifies GSE68060.
references.relevance: Additional provenance for the expanded current GSE68060 series.
references.caution: Use downloaded GEO metadata for the current included sample count. The study does not establish a numeric-code mapping for every donor or identify M/P title letters as metastatic/primary status.
